- Overestimate prices after recent spikes, especially when sentiment is positive (0.17+), and correct by 3–5% downward in next 3–5 days.  
- Underestimate prices when sentiment is negative (-0.22–0.00) and recent prices are trending upward — adjust forecast upward by 2–4% to match momentum.  
- Lagging forecasts often overreact to sentiment shifts — apply a 1–2 day smoothing filter to reduce lagged overshoot.  
- Mean reversion bias: if forecast is >10% above recent 5-day average, reduce by 1–3% per day until convergence.  
- For 30-day horizon, avoid sharp upward revisions after 2+ consecutive negative sentiment days — cap forecast increase at 2% unless sentiment turns strongly positive.
